## Broadcom Stock Price Performance

The _Broadcom (AVGO) stock chart_ highlights key performance trends across multiple timeframes. Over the last 12 months, the stock's price has increased **45.23%**, with a **year-to-date return of 15.56%**. In the past month, the stock has increased **7.49%**, reflecting recent market activity. 

As of the latest close, _Broadcom traded at $399.97_ with a **market cap of $1.90 trillion** and **volume of 14.58 million shares**. Five years ago, the stock traded at a split-adjusted price of **$48.02**, representing a **732.96%** increase over that period. At the time, it had a **market cap of $197.00 billion** and a **volume of 16.75 million shares**.
